description: This is a Perl test script from the curl project that verifies synchronization of deprecated function statuses, enums, options, and symbols across header files, man pages, and version documentation.
published: symbol deprecation statuses, function, enum, and option deprecation info used for internal verification

methods.name: scan_header
methods.description: Scans a header file for public function and enum value deprecations, marking their deprecation version.

methods.name: scan_man_for_opts
methods.description: Scans a man page to identify options and their deprecation status.

methods.name: scan_man_page
methods.description: Recursively scans a man page for deprecations in DESCRIPTION and AVAILABILITY sections.
